$comment: Quality gates for comfyui-workflow-sync. Generated by cradle/project-install. HONEST STATE: this repository currently has no test suite, no linter, no formatter and no CI. Most gates below are therefore declared but NOT enforceable yet — each carries an explicit `enforceable` flag. Do not treat a passing run as evidence of quality until the corresponding tool is actually added.

testCoverage.note: No tests exist (0 test files across 31 commits). Minimum is 0 so gates do not block on a metric that cannot be produced. Raise to the target only after a pytest suite exists. First priority per tool-selection: characterization tests pinning _classify_node / extract_models / extract_models_api / extract_custom_nodes, the four functions that absorbed 15 of 31 commits.

recommended.rationale: Standard Python linter; fits uv-managed projects with no config overhead.
Same toolchain as linting; avoids adding a second dependency.
54 of 69 defs in main.py already carry modern type hints, so adoption cost is low.

commitChecks.description: If main.py changes the /analyze, /size or /sync request or response shape, static/index.html must change in the same commit. This coupling caused a real production breakage (178e53f); main.py and static/index.html co-changed in 9 commits.
commitChecks.note: Manual gate until a contract test exists. Documented in CLAUDE.md.

commitChecks.description: No real AWS keys or secret values in tracked files; .env stays untracked, only .env.example is edited

deployGates.description: App imports and starts without a missing-config crash (fail-fast at import on missing COMFYUI_PATH is expected behaviour, not a failure)
AWS CLI v2 is on PATH — every S3 operation shells out to it, there is no boto3 fallback
README.md and .env.example reflect the env vars main.py actually reads
deployGates.note: Known drift as of this install: README/.env.example omit AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3, CM_REGISTRY_URL, APP_PORT, PORT, APP_HOST, CONFIG, INDEX_TTL. README last touched 2026-05-19, 21 code commits ago.

cicdIntegration.note: CI/CD integration was explicitly declined by the project owner during this install. No .github/ files were created. Re-run cradle/project-install to add a pipeline once ruff and pytest exist; until then generated gates would be cosmetic.
